Maria Gomez: Quick async check-in: finished onboarding tiny-llama-7B-v2 to staging last night. Ran eval sweep (~3k cases) against our summarization + qna promptsets. High-level: latency ok, token costs within expected, but summarization quality dropped ~6% on ROUGE-L for one prompt cluster. attaching short notes.
Alex Li: Can you paste the eval numbers and which prompt cluster failed? Need to know if it's model or prompt regression.
Maria Gomez: Sure. Fail cluster = "legal_summary_v2" (longer context ~1.5k). Metrics: ROUGE-L -6.2; F1 (qa) -1.1; latency +0.02s. Most diffs around clause truncation and hallucinated citations. Sample: "The court..." -> missing last paragraph.
Priya Nair: Hmm, could be tokenization or kv-cache miss for long context. Did you run with same quantization/kv settings as previous model?
Maria Gomez: Yes, same config: 4-bit quant, kv-cache enabled. Eval command I used:
```
python infra/eval.py --model tiny-llama-7B-v2 --promptsets summarization,qa --quant 4bit --kv-cache --seed 42 --out /tmp/ttv2-results.json
```
Tao Chen: I can take a look at the KV cache traces. If it's an off-by-one in prefix handling we can repro locally. Ping me the sample ID.
Maria Gomez: sample id 2026-07-19-legal-0314 in the results file. Also noticed one edge case where input had embedded newlines + list numbering.
Alex Li: @Priya can you try a quick prompt normalization patch? strip extra newlines + collapse numbered lists -> see if ROUGE improves.
Priya Nair: On it. Will run a normalized pass against the failing cluster, compare diffs. ETA ~2h.
Infra Bot: deploy-bot: staging model tiny-llama-7B-v2 deployed at 2026-07-19T07:03:12Z to pool-2 (sha: a1b2c3)
Tao Chen: Filing a tiny KVC-trace issue: https://jira/redwood/ML-2842 with sample + stack. I'll add logs and a minimal repro script.
Maria Gomez: blocker: I can't run the heavy regen locally (no GPU). If normalization doesn't fix, we may need someone to run a full regen on staging to confirm. @Alex any capacity on dedicated pool today?
Alex Li: I can spin up a quick 1xA100 on dedicated for an hour later this afternoon, if that helps. I'll DM infra to approve cost. :thumbsup:
Priya Nair: If Alex can run it, I'll trigger a full eval and start a canary A/B with prompt normalization vs baseline.
Maria Gomez: Thanks all. I'll add the failing samples to the PR comment and link the eval results. If Priya sees improvement we can ship a prompt patch; otherwise Tao's kv-trace will guide next steps. 
Alex Li: I'll review the PR once you post it. Expect review by EOD. 
Maria Gomez: Thanks team — leaving notes in the model-onboard board. Will update thread when I have normalized-run results.
